{{2011–12 Big Ten men's basketball standings}}
The '''2011–12 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign]] in the [[2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. This was head coach [[Bruce Weber (basketball)|Bruce Weber]]'s ninth and final season at Illinois. The Illini played their home games at [[Assembly Hall (Champaign)|Assembly Hall]] and were members of the [[Big Ten Conference]].

===2011–12 incoming team members===
Prior to the 2011–12 season, Illinois welcomed seven new players into the program.  The 2011 [[Recruiting (college athletics)|recruiting class]] was ranked No. 13 by [[Scout.com]] and No. 11 by both [[Rivals.com]] and [[ESPNU]].  The class was celebrated for its talent and depth, and is the second class in a row that has revived top-15 national rankings.  Six true freshman; '''Tracy Abrams''', '''Myke Henry''', '''Devin Langford''', '''Nnanna Egwu''', '''Mike Shaw''', and '''Ibby Djimde''' as well as one transfer senior, '''Sam Maniscalco''' joined the 2011–12 team. Maniscalso transferred from [[Bradley University]] after graduating in May 2011.  Because Bradley did not offer the graduate program he enrolled in at Illinois, Maniscalco was eligible to play immediately.<ref name="Media Guide">{{cite web |url=http://grfx.cstv.com/photos/schools/ill/sports/m-baskbl/auto_pdf/2011-12/misc_non_event/2011-12_Illini_MBK_RecordBook.pdf |title=2011-12 Illinois Basketball Record Book |author=University of Illinois |date=October 14, 2011 |publisher=University of Illinois |access-date=December 28, 2011 |archive-date=December 16, 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111216025829/http://grfx.cstv.com/photos/schools/ill/sports/m-baskbl/auto_pdf/2011-12/misc_non_event/2011-12_Illini_MBK_RecordBook.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref>

===Italy Trip===
Prior to the start of fall semester classes, the team embarked on a 10-day international tour of [[Italy]] in August, 2011. With stops in [[Rome]], [[Florence]], [[Venice]], and [[Como]] the trip was a combination of basketball, sightseeing, and team-building. The team played four full games, which included wins over Roma Select, Castellanza Select, and Fulgor Omegna as well as an overtime loss to the [[New Zealand]] National team<ref>{{cite news |title=Italy: Learning experience and a great trip to boot |author=Paul Klee |url=http://www.illinihq.com/sports/illini-sports/mens-basketball/2011-08-20/italy-learning-experience-and-great-trip-boot.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120421174431/http://www.illinihq.com/sports/illini-sports/mens-basketball/2011-08-20/italy-learning-experience-and-great-trip-boot.html |url-status=live |archive-date=April 21, 2012 |newspaper=[[The News-Gazette (Champaign-Urbana)|News-Gazette]] |date=August 20, 2011 |access-date=December 28, 2011 }}</ref> Also, the Illini traveled to [[Aviano Air Base]], where Illinois played [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia]] in a 20-minute scrimmage and the Aviano varsity team in a 10-minute scrimmage.
